Maria: Customer reported: console panels show spinning indicator, panels never load. Network tab shows 500 responses from /api/analytics/query and occasional 504s. Happening across multiple dashboards for org org_8242. Impacting live dashboards for a few customers.

Ajay: Can you paste minimal repro steps and one failing request body + correlation id? Also which region?

Maria: Repro steps: 1) Login as user in org_8242 2) Open Console -> Analytics -> select any dashboard 3) Expand time range to last 30d 4) Panel issues on initial load. Example failing request:
```bash
curl -i -X POST \"https://api.redwood.example.com/api/analytics/query\" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxx' \n  -d '{"query":"select count(*) from events where ts >= now()-30d","range":{"start":"2026-02-01","end":"2026-03-01"}}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Body: {"error":"query_timeout","correlation_id":"c2f4e9b0-7a3a-11ec-9a4b-0242ac110002"}
Region: us-west-2. First seen ~2026-03-10 09:12 UTC.

Kevin: I see matching correlation_id in logs. Many queries hitting analytics-aggregator service are getting forwarded to ClickHouse and timing out. Error pattern: `ClickHouse: Timeout while executing query` and `aggregator: queue_wait_exceeded`.

DeployBot: Alert: analytics-aggregator (svc/analytics-aggregator-prod) increased 500 rate by 18% in us-west-2. Incident created: INC-2026-304 (link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-304).

Ajay: Short-term mitigation: reduce query parallelism and bump clickhouse_read_timeout to 90s for affected hosts. Workaround for customers: change the dashboard time range to a smaller window (e.g., last 24h) or enable cached results by adding `?use_cache=true` to the query endpoint.

Maria: Passed workaround to customer; they've confirmed small window helps but need full-range historical dashboards. Providing list of affected org ids: [org_8242, org_9001, org_7765].

Kevin: We'll schedule a canary restart of analytics-aggregator in us-west-2 and add temporary rate-limits per-org to avoid head-of-line blocking. Deploy at 2026-03-10T10:30 UTC.

Lina: How many customers impacted and is billing affected? Any evidence this is a regression from last deploy?

Kevin: Early signal shows spike started after the midnight deploy 2026-03-10 (deploy id: d-2026-03-10-0003). Rolling back that deploy reduces 500s in canary. We should consider rollback if restart+config bump doesn't fix. Billing not directly affected but dashboards failing increases support load.

Ajay: Filed infra ticket INF-4723, assigned to eng-sre. Action items: 1) canary restart analytics-aggregator 2) increase ClickHouse read timeout 3) enable per-org rate limiting on aggregator 4) follow-up postmortem if rollback needed.

Maria: Escalating to the customer's AM. Marking this as P1 for affected enterprise accounts. I'll update ticket with customer's SLA impact.

Kevin: Will monitor metrics and post status in INC-2026-304. If we see error rate drop below 1% post-canary, we'll proceed with gradual rollout.

Maria: Thanks team. I'll keep the customer updated and post any new correlation_ids here. :thumbsup:
